precedence_rule: Layer 1 chapters state the customer's requirements; the L2 register map states what the profile currently implements. Neither silently overrides the other; a difference is a pending ruling.
Within Layer 1 the later version supersedes the earlier (Ch.2 v1.1 > v1.0). Chapter 5 Appendix 5.A is the consolidated state as of 2026-09-24.
The architect's rulings resolve differences. Until ruled, a code-generating agent implements the Layer 1 requirement AND flags the difference; it never picks one side silently.

prelude_2026_05.summary: The architect presented PTSG (four opcodes; Stay separating time from state; shadow execution; 16 timing signals; 1-bit external Condition). Approach 1 (fixed pipeline, Stay-counted) chosen for WPMS; Approach 2 kept as a trailer. The architect introduced the period layers L1 bin / L2 packet (new) / L3 sample / L4 control and the governing question 'at which layer should each coefficient be computed?', placing the Gaussian's exp() initial values at L4 and A_{k+1}=A_k·M_k, M_{k+1}=M_k·C at L1. Upper/Lower PTSG proposed by Claude and accepted (same IP, two instances). PTSG spun off as its own Open Prompt repository and Hackaday.io project; this session became a PTSG user; customer requirements R1–R7, W1–W2 written.
context: 2026-05-06 Hackaday.com feature 'Taking Polyphony To A New Level' (Jenny List): 'an SDR for the world of acoustics'
2026-05-30 Build Log 'The Despair of a 300-Meter-Long Hammond Organ' presented the four-layer architecture publicly

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Returns: PTSG-Core in on-board debug on DE10-nano; path Core → CPU-Formation → PTSG-WPMS-Formation, which becomes the L2 Formation; the upper layer to be reconsidered later. Relays the profile amanuensis's three points.

turns.speaker: PTSG-WPMS-Formation amanuensis (relayed)
turns.content_summary_en: (1) Unified correction of Ch.2 § 2.5: 2,083 clocks vs 2,048 bins per module per sample; the 35-clock difference is pipeline-overhead margin, not a per-bin budget; ~17 is pipeline depth, a different quantity. (2) The f → φ mapping belongs to no one. (3) It will supply the ISA-visible register map; Q and wiring belong to Ch.3; R2(b) solved by 32-bit integer ports.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Accepts the correction; lists owners A (L4), B (L2 page), C (host) for f → φ, leaning A; accepts the integer-width / Q split as a clean Open Prompt boundary.

turns.speaker: PTSG-WPMS-Formation amanuensis (relayed)
turns.content_summary_en: 1/48000 is a constant: the mapping is one MAC by a reciprocal in any layer, so cost does not decide; the deciding factor is who knows Fs and at which period f changes. The page will carry phase-domain 32-bit integers (Δφ₀, Δ²φ, Δ³φ), valid under A or C.

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Rules L4-Formation outside WPMS, realized first as a verification tool in a new Open Prompt Layer 4 (verification), to be grown toward a MIDI interpreter; keeps L4's many functions from delaying WPMS. Delivers Deliverable 1 (register map v0.1).

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Customer review of Deliverable 1: Q column (PH*/OM* Q0.32 modular; A0 Q1.31; AR1/AR2/E0 Q4.28, SHV 28), RT.OUT numbering, slot set complete (third order not needed), Mode T supported, Ch.2 errata; notes that phase is exact with zero drift and L1 never reads OM*. Recorded by the profile as the '09-07 answers'.

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Publishes the PTSG-WPMS-Formation repository; ratifies the Q proposals (W-R10); asks for Ch.2 v1.1 first; asks whether Deliverables 2 and 3 are in the repository.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Reviews the repository (register map v0.2, Decision Register W v0.5): Deliverables 2–3 not yet issued. Issues Ch.2 v1.1 (two errata; vocabulary L1/L2/L4).

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Asks for the full Chapter 3, stating undecided points top-down as customer requirements; he and the profile will work to realize them.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Drafts Ch.3: period layers and placement principle; exact phase path; amplitude moved to log₂ (retracting its own ratified proposal, with evidence); exp2 unit; sweep timing budget (7-clock slack); CR3-xx; test-origin integers.

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Rules C3-D1 Fixed. Defers the amplitude domain and the relay of requirements until Ch.4 (expected to be closely related). The profile amanuensis will read all of Layer 1 after Ch.5 and, except where truly infeasible, work with the architect to realize the customer's intent.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Drafts Ch.4 (output path): log-domain amplitude meets no obstacle and helps (master gain = one adder, constant-dB fades, soft mute; sign lives in the phase). Crest factor: Dirichlet 36.1 dB vs Schroeder ψ = π/N 5.6 dB. Audio domain masters L3. MiSTer as prior art. Latency defined.

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Approves 'regenerate from documents and this chapter' for the MiSTer boundary as ideal; approves the latency disclosure and will use it in publication; asks for Ch.5.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Drafts Ch.5: stage–arm–go; continuity law; level glide (CR5-L1, LPT at +0x9); phase-shape velocity ≡ frequency shape; four-port input switch with ownership; address map; JTAG MM master; ROM port for the test origin; camera mapper contract; Appendix 5.A for the full review.

turns.speaker: Ohnaka
turns.content_summary_en: Asks what a Layer 2 trace should record to help the profile amanuensis and Claude Code; then asks for this trace and a consolidated oracle.

turns.speaker: Claude
turns.content_summary_en: Builds the oracle (18 checks, all PASS, ~3 s); while consolidating, finds and records two measurement pitfalls and the consistent-derivation guideline; writes this trace.

decision_points.chosen: only phase/log integers cross the WPMS boundary; L4 converts (C3-D1)
decision_points.rationale: the profile's insight: cost is one reciprocal MAC anywhere; decisive is who knows Fs and when f changes

decision_points.chosen: outside, first as a verification tool
decision_points.rationale: L4's functions are many; keep the earliest-sound path short

γ = 1e-4 (σ = 71 bins) gives a₀ ≈ 2.9e-46 → Q1.31 0 → silent packet; loop-carried multiply at one bin per clock; 0.58 % truncation bias even when representable. In log₂ the recurrence is exact integer addition (products become sums).

evidence.result: 18 checks, all PASS, about 3 s; a deliberately wrong expectation yields FAIL and exit status 1

checks.CH3-UNDERFLOW: σ = 71 and σ = 22 silent in the linear domain
checks.CH3-E2E: σ = 71 plays: 927 audible bins; exp2-only 2^-24.2; slot quantization 2^-12.3 naive, 2^-15.1 consistent
checks.CH4-CREST: 36.12 / 5.60 / 12.17 dB; levels at G = 12 and G = 8

measurement_pitfalls: Relative error near the format floor: over outputs down to 2^-23 the exp2 error reads 2^-8 — that is the Q1.31 LSB. Measure relative error where the format has the bits (a ≥ 2^-7); absolute error in LSBs everywhere.
An apex on the clamp: a Gaussian with A0 = 1 sits on the per-bin clamp (a ≤ 1); rounding pushes it over and the clamp reads as 2^-15.7 error. Test at A0 < 1.
Realized vs requested parameters: integers quantize parameters (1/256 Hz → 350, not 349.53). Silicon plays the realized integers; bit-level regression compares against them.
evidence.guideline_for_L4_tool: Consistent derivation: round the highest-order slot first (LAD2) and derive LAD1 and LS0 from the rounded value, keeping the apex at N/2 and level A0. Deviation from the requested Gaussian falls from 2^-12.3 to 2^-15.1 at no cost.

acceptance_conditions.condition: phase of every bin equals the closed form Φ_k(n) exactly
log-amplitude equals its closed form exactly; 54-bit accumulators never wrap
exp2 ≤ 12 LSB absolute; ≤ 2^-24 relative for a ≥ 2^-7; test with A0 < 1
an armed item is applied exactly once, whole, on the same sample in every module; APPLIED_SAMPLE reports it; frozen writes are rejected and counted
a commit whose mask holds only [P] slots produces no phase or level discontinuity
level glide: steps ≤ rate, no overshoot, exact arrival; LE0 = 0 freezes
test-origin integers; peak −6.3 dBFS at G = 12
saturation never wraps; clip flags are sticky

design_pattern_candidates.name: Period-Layer Placement
design_pattern_candidates.statement: compute each quantity in the slowest period layer at which it changes

design_pattern_candidates.name: Adders in the Loop
design_pattern_candidates.statement: one-clock loops carry additions only; curvature is applied once, feed-forward

design_pattern_candidates.name: Products Become Sums
design_pattern_candidates.statement: a multiplicative recurrence in log coordinates loses its underflow, its loop multiply and its bias, and every levelizer on it becomes linear

design_pattern_candidates.name: Stage–Arm–Go
design_pattern_candidates.statement: writers stage, arm with a mask, and fire; changes land whole on one sample everywhere

design_pattern_candidates.name: Continuity Law
design_pattern_candidates.statement: write the constants, let the state flow; to move the phase shape, move the frequencies

design_pattern_candidates.name: Regenerate, Don't Copy
design_pattern_candidates.statement: resolve a license boundary by regenerating small blocks from primary documents and the spec

design_pattern_candidates.name: Evidence-Driven Retraction
design_pattern_candidates.statement: a ratified proposal is withdrawn, with its evidence, when drafting exposes a hardware fact; the retraction is recorded, not hidden

themes.title: Open Prompt across repositories, in practice
themes.summary: requirements carry IDs; messages are relayed; correction runs both ways — the profile corrected the customer's numbers (Ch.2), the customer retracted its own ratified proposal (Ch.3)

themes.title: Exactness as architecture
themes.summary: phase and log-amplitude are integers end to end; the 2020 First Sound coherence becomes a theorem

themes.title: Log coordinates keep paying
themes.summary: no underflow; master gain as one adder; constant-dB fades; soft mute; level glide; dB-linear camera control

themes.title: Phase as a hidden instrument
themes.summary: ψ = π/N (Schroeder, 1970) cuts crest factor from 36.1 to 5.6 dB; sign lives in the phase; moving the phase shape is shaping the frequencies

themes.title: Honest boundaries
themes.summary: oracle is not silicon; board facts to confirm; MiSTer consulted not copied; latency defined interval by interval; measurement pitfalls recorded

resumption_hooks.title: full review by the profile amanuensis
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Which customer requirements of Appendix 5.A are infeasible or costly in the L2 profile — especially CR5-L1's clamp (and its effect on N_min) and CR3-B1's zero-gap seven-word bundle — and what counter-proposals preserve their intent?

resumption_hooks.title: packet-boundary gap on PTSG-Core
resumption_hooks.starting_question: When a Stay times out and the next state is a Stay Set, does the Core spend an idle clock? If so, can the next Stay's first count be presented on the following clock (g = 0, CR3-T1)?

resumption_hooks.title: bit-accurate golden model of one sweep
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Extend the oracle with Ch.2's Maclaurin formats, the Q1.63 product, the accumulators and the output stage; publish the test origin's first 48,000 PCM samples as the tier-(i) regression reference.

resumption_hooks.title: Layer 4 verification tool
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Build the host tool: Hz/dB → integers with consistent derivation, the mask presets of Appendix 5.B, stage–arm–go over System Console; measure JTAG round-trip time and write throughput.

resumption_hooks.title: v1.1 of Chapters 1 and 3
resumption_hooks.starting_question: After the rulings, apply Appendix 5.A.3 to Ch.1 and Ch.3; which items change once the profile's answers to hook A are known?

resumption_hooks.title: optional camera chapter
resumption_hooks.starting_question: Specify the frame aggregator and the mapping-table encoding, and find a first playable mapping that respects the continuity law.
